markov_optimization.changed: Only nonzero source-draw rows of the transition matrix are computed. The final matrix shape and dot product remain unchanged. Integer transition counts and normalized scores are identical.
markov_optimization.cache_change: none: scorer output, pools and folds are unchanged
markov_optimization.timing_limit: CPU microbenchmark on this station under concurrent load; not an end-to-end speedup claim.

conclusions: The registry has 53 entries: 2 baselines, 50 existing methods and 1 benchmark-only experimental interval method. Earlier 52-entry documentation is historical.
Current local folds contain 824 rows and all 4 games. The 28 failed rows are the seven single-pick co-occurrence methods, which correctly have no usable signal.
At pool16 target4 and Urna2 top1, no selected method demonstrates excess performance after Holm correction within its cell. Historical rankings do not establish future superiority.

The existing 1002-method screen (2026-10-10), 491-scorer screen (2026-10-05) and external confirmations promoted no new predictor. This audit does not switch production scorers. The corrected DMD requires a complete Re-Bench before any new ranking is current.
No production histories, benchmark outputs or saved decisions are written.
snapshot_caveat: The saved v22 decision/folds describe histories through 15-10-2026. The current histories additionally contain the 18-10-2026 draws. The table audits those saved results, not newly evaluated current draws. The DMD correction also changes scorer semantics, so a complete v23 Re-Bench is required before selecting under the corrected engine. Production outputs were intentionally preserved.

dmd_correction.problem: At the rank-six boundary, repeated singular values were cut through an arbitrary SVD basis. Re-labelling Urna 2 balls changed normalized scores by 0.0975998656 on the current 700-row fixture; the defect was independently reproduced from HEAD.
dmd_correction.fix: Retain the whole numerical-tie singular block (rtol 1e-10, atol 1e-12), still excluding singular values <=1e-8. Flatten null forecasts with raw variation <=1e-12 rather than amplifying roundoff.
dmd_correction.tests: Exact and near degeneracy, twelve relabellings for each, unchanged distinct-spectrum results, short/constant input, null-projection roundoff; existing current-history equivariance regression.
dmd_correction.invalidation: Benchmark v23; DMD-specific WF scorer semantic tag; worker v20. Frozen forward-test copies are unchanged.

summary.limits: Complete audit of the saved v22 folds/decision through 15-10-2026, without evaluating new draws. The DMD correction requires complete v23 Re-Bench before any ranking describes the corrected engine. Holm is corrected within each cell, not across 46 cells or through external validation.
